items.title: Jay Leonhart interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: By the early ‘60s, Jay was performing with top jazz artists including Mike Longo and Buddy Morrow.

ctx.x: Jay Leonhart is a first-call bassist as well as a talented singer and songwriter.

He was born in 1940 in Baltimore, and received his music education at Berklee School of Music and Oscar Peterson’s School for Contemporary Music. By the early ‘60s, Jay was performing with top jazz artists including Mike Longo and Buddy Morrow. He has recorded with Marian McPartland, Jane Jarvis, the New York Swing Trio, and numerous vocal artists. He is currently devoting an increasing amount of time to his songwriting and singing endeavors.
Jay was interviewed in San Diego, California on February 15, 1998, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
